hub_unreachable.title: ezloPi hub {serial} is unreachable
hub_unreachable.description: Home Assistant can't reach ezloPi hub {serial} on the local network. Check that the hub is powered on, connected to the same network as Home Assistant, and discoverable via mDNS (_ezlo._tcp). The hub will reconnect automatically once reachable.

set_canvas.name: Set canvas
set_canvas.description: Write a run of pixels to an LED strip's canvas framebuffer, putting it into the on-device image effect. Call repeatedly to draw an arbitrary image. Tip: lower brightness (around 30) renders dense multi-colour images most truly; the firmware only raises brightness to a visible floor if it was 0.

entity_id.name: Strip
entity_id.description: The LED strip to draw on (its light entity or its canvas sensor).

start.name: Start pixel
start.description: Index of the first pixel in this run (chain/row-major order).

rgb.name: Pixels (hex)
rgb.description: Pixel colours as hex, 6 characters (RRGGBB) per pixel, one run in chain order. Spaces are ignored.

draw_image.name: Draw image
draw_image.description: Load an image file, resize it to the LED strip's pixel geometry and draw it onto the canvas.

entity_id.name: Strip
entity_id.description: The LED strip to draw on (its light entity or its canvas sensor).

image.name: Image path
image.description: Path to an image file. Its directory must be in allowlist_external_dirs (e.g. /config/www).
